title: Coastal cliff road convertible: same prompt on Seedance 2.5 vs Kling 4.0
prompt_text: @Image1 is the scene: a winding coastal cliff road at golden hour, dramatic sea cliffs, turquoise water, low warm sun. A single vintage dark-green convertible drives along the road. Action: the convertible drives toward the camera around the bend, then past it along the cliff edge; waves break white against the rocks below; long shadows; dust lifts slightly behind the tyres. Camera: slow aerial drone shot tracking alongside the car, anamorphic cinematic look, 21:9. Sound: the engine note, wind, waves crashing below. No music.
